measures.what: overall diameter of the round board
measures.reply: led disk diameter: I can't measure that

measures.what: thickness of the board
measures.reply: led disk thickness: I can't measure that

measures.what: the two small mounting holes near the centre: their diameter, and their centres' distance from the board centre and from each other (and whether they're a matched pair straddling the centre)
measures.reply: led disk hole diameter: 3.3 mm (each of the two small holes near the centre); led disk diameter: I can't measure that

measures.what: length and width of the board
measures.reply: perfboard size: 50 x 70 mm

measures.what: thickness of the board
measures.reply: perfboard thickness: I can't measure that

measures.what: the four corner holes: their diameter, and how far each hole's centre is inset from the two nearest board edges
measures.reply: perfboard corner holes: 2.4 mm across, and 0.9 mm from the edge of each hole to the board's edge

measures.what: where the USB-C port sits on the perfboard: which edge it's on, how far the port mouth is from that edge, how far it is from the adjacent edges, and how high the port mouth is above the perfboard top face
measures.reply: esp32 height: it stands about 16 mm above the perfboard in its female headers; 11.05 mm of that is to the underside of its board; esp32 position: in female headers on the perfboard's columns 8 and 18, rows 2 to 23; esp32 usb port: 4.80 mm from the outside of its USB-C port to the nearest edge of the ESP32 board, and 7.53 mm from the ESP32's edge to the perfboard's edge; esp32 usb port height: the bottom of its USB-C receptacle is 12.54 mm above the perfboard's top, and the receptacle is about 3.2 mm tall and 10.67 mm wide, its centre 3.99 mm off the ESP32's centreline

measures.what: diameter across the disc through its centre — a ruler or tape laid across it is fine, calipers aren't needed
measures.reply: led disk diameter: I can't measure that

measures.what: the two small near-centre mounting holes: distance between their two centres, and how far each centre is from the disc's centre (a sketch or rough reading is fine)
measures.reply: led disk hole diameter: 3.3 mm (each of the two small holes near the centre); led disk between holes: 30.2 mm (from the nearest edge of each hole, with calipers pulled in at the edges)

measures.what: thickness of the disc at its edge (a ruler against the edge is fine)
measures.reply: led disk hole to edge: 102.54 from the outside of one hole to the disk's edge, and 102.24 from the other hole to the other side mm; led disk thickness: I can't measure that

measures.what: thickness at its edge (a ruler is fine)
measures.reply: perfboard thickness: I can't measure that

measures.what: the USB-C port mouth: which perfboard edge does the port face toward (a 50 mm edge or a 70 mm edge), and how far is the mouth's centre from each of the two nearest perfboard edges
measures.reply: esp32 usb port: 4.80 mm from the outside of its USB-C port to the nearest edge of the ESP32 board, and 7.53 mm from the ESP32's edge to the perfboard's edge

measures.what: circumference: wrap a strip of paper or string right around the outside of the disc, mark where it overlaps, lay it flat and measure that length in mm (I'll get the diameter from it)
measures.reply: led disk hole positions: on a line through the centre, one at 3 o'clock and one at 9 o'clock, with the input wires at 12; led disk diameter: I can't measure that

measures.what: thickness: look at the disc edge-on — roughly is the board about 1.5 mm thick (thin PCB), 2–3 mm, or thicker?
measures.reply: led disk hole to edge: 102.54 from the outside of one hole to the disk's edge, and 102.24 from the other hole to the other side mm; led disk thickness: I can't measure that

measures.what: the 4-pin input connector on the back: roughly how far is it from the disc's centre, and which way does it point relative to the line between the two mounting holes (in line with them, at 90°, or some other angle)?
measures.reply: led disk hole diameter: 3.3 mm (each of the two small holes near the centre); led disk between holes: 30.2 mm (from the nearest edge of each hole, with calipers pulled in at the edges); led disk hole positions: on a line through the centre, one at 3 o'clock and one at 9 o'clock, with the input wires at 12

measures.what: the shortest distance from the 3 o'clock mounting hole straight outward to the NEAREST point of the disc's edge (right-hand rim) — call it A
measures.reply: led disk hole diameter: 3.3 mm (each of the two small holes near the centre); led disk hole to edge: 102.54 from the outside of one hole to the disk's edge, and 102.24 from the other hole to the other side mm; led disk hole positions: on a line through the centre, one at 3 o'clock and one at 9 o'clock, with the input wires at 12

measures.what: from that same 3 o'clock hole, straight across through the centre, to the far (left-hand) rim — call it B; I'll add A + B to get the diameter
measures.reply: led disk hole diameter: 3.3 mm (each of the two small holes near the centre); led disk hole to edge: 102.54 from the outside of one hole to the disk's edge, and 102.24 from the other hole to the other side mm; led disk hole positions: on a line through the centre, one at 3 o'clock and one at 9 o'clock, with the input wires at 12; led disk diameter: I can't measure that

measures.what: the 4-pin input connector on the back: how far is it from the disc centre, roughly how big is it (length and width), and how far does it stand proud of the disc's flat back face?
measures.reply: led disk diameter: I can't measure that

measures.what: thickness of just the circuit board at the edge: is it about 1.5 mm (thin PCB), 2–3 mm, or thicker? (ignore the LEDs sticking up)
measures.reply: led disk hole to edge: 102.54 from the outside of one hole to the disk's edge, and 102.24 from the other hole to the other side mm; led disk thickness: I can't measure that

measures.what: rough size check: is the disc's overall diameter bigger than 20 cm? (for example, does it overhang a 20 cm / 8-inch ruler, or fit within a sheet of A5 paper, which is 21 cm wide)
measures.reply: led disk diameter: I can't measure that

measures.what: the 4-pin input connector on the back at 12 o'clock: roughly how far is it from the disc's centre, how big is it, and how far does it stick up off the flat back face of the disc?
measures.reply: led disk hole positions: on a line through the centre, one at 3 o'clock and one at 9 o'clock, with the input wires at 12

measures.what: the SHORTEST distance from the edge of the 3 o'clock mounting hole straight outward to the nearest point of the disc's rim (straight to the right). This is the small gap between the hole and the outside edge on that side.
measures.reply: led disk hole diameter: 3.3 mm (each of the two small holes near the centre); led disk between holes: 30.2 mm (from the nearest edge of each hole, with calipers pulled in at the edges); led disk hole to edge: 102.54 from the outside of one hole to the disk's edge, and 102.24 from the other hole to the other side mm; led disk hole positions: on a line through the centre, one at 3 o'clock and one at 9 o'clock, with the input wires at 12

limitations.wanted: to measure the LED disc's overall diameter and board thickness directly with calipers
limitations.blocked_by: the disc is larger than the person's caliper span, so they could only give hole-to-edge readings and hole positions
limitations.why: the whole box is sized to the disc, so I had to derive the diameter from the hole-to-edge readings and flag it as an assumption
